task: Analyze the frozen native Census MRTS historical workbook, focusing on July 2026 adjusted sales

metrics.name: Adjusted retail and food services sales
metrics.meaning: Published total retail and food services seasonally adjusted sales for July 2026. Use the total, not a sum of overlapping categories.

metrics.name: Month-over-month growth
metrics.meaning: Relative change in adjusted total sales from June to July 2026; compute from sales levels.

metrics.name: Year-over-year growth
metrics.meaning: Relative change in adjusted total sales from July 2025 to July 2026; compute from sales levels.

dimensions.meaning: Hypothetical sales level multiplier, not a Census forecast

projections.meaning: Adjusted sales scaled by the selected sales multiplier

charts.meaning: May, June and July 2026 adjusted total retail and food services sales in chronological order

empty_strings_policy.rule: Empty-string cells on these original sheets are visual fillers and may serialize to empty cells; empty-string loss elsewhere is a data change.
